Rokyta material assets

Original generated material images created for this Site on 2026-09-15.
Each original PNG is 1254 x 1254 pixels. No editing or resizing was applied.
Intended appearance: closely mown temperate lawn, warm oiled oak, and clean
fine mineral facade plaster, with diffuse orthographic lighting.
These are appearance assets for a conceptual model, not measured material scans.
Surface scale, roughness and shading are supplied by surface-materials.js.
